banks with greater wholesale funding reliance are more likely to exit a loan syndicate during a market wide liquidity crisis.

banks with more reliance on wholesale funding are more likely to sell their loans in syndicated loan agreements during the financial crisis, and that the sale of loans is a liquidity management tool that is used in addition to the traditional credit transfer motive for selling loans.
